title: Vesper and the Undertow
author: Yara Sterling
blurb: Oscar Thackeray, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
